artifacts.content:
# Impact Assessment: ClaimsIntake Hub

## Legend
| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Source 1 | PRD: `L0-requirements-prd-composer`|
| Status (*Draft / In-Review / Approved*) | Draft |
| Approved by (Human Name) | *Human Name* |
| Date of Approval | *Date* |
| Human Approval Comments | *Comments* |

> KB: kb-L0-architecture-principles (Confluence page_id 524091393) — mode: cross-check mode (catalog and CMDB populated)

## Executive Summary & Overview
ClaimsIntake Hub is the digital front door for motor and property claims: it captures FNOL, validates coverage, gathers evidence, pre-screens for fraud and keeps policyholders informed, feeding adjusters downstream.

Four new components are introduced and three existing systems (PolicyAdmin-Core, DocVault, Notify-Hub) are extended. The highest blast radius sits on the new Claims Intake Service and on PolicyAdmin-Core, which every claim validation calls. The retiring claims mainframe is excluded, but the CMDB still shows a live relationship to it, which is flagged.
- **Overall impact level:** High — 2 of 8 FR rows are High (Claims Intake Service, PolicyAdmin-Core) on the synchronous claim path
- **Existing systems:** 3 impacted, 2 explicitly excluded by architecture decision; duplicate-build risk: none found
- **External dependencies:** 3 total, 2 newly surfaced by this assessment
- **Flags:** CMDB/KB mismatch: CMDB REL-3002 shows Legacy-Claims-Mainframe feeding PolicyAdmin-Core; KB marks mainframe retired; KB-mandatory API Gateway and Identity Provider absent from PRD; added as external dependencies

## Non-Functional & Regulatory Impact
The 2 s p95 acknowledgement target (CON-001) puts PolicyAdmin-Core coverage lookups on the synchronous path; its current SLA must be confirmed. The 10-year retention (CON-002) applies to the new Claim Status Store and to DocVault attachments. PII encryption (CON-003) applies to all new components; Notify-Hub must not include claim detail in SMS bodies.

## Existing-System Impact
**Capability check (service catalog, service grain):** Closest catalog matches: SVC-101 Policy Admin Service (coverage lookup only — no claim intake, reused for FR-002/FR-003); SVC-102 Document Management Service (reused for FR-004); SVC-103 Notification Service (reused for FR-006); SVC-104 Fraud Scoring Service (scoring API only, no triage workflow — consumed as an external dependency for FR-005). No catalog service covers FNOL capture or claim status tracking, so no duplicate-build risk.

**Technical impact check (CMDB, configuration-item grain):**

| Existing System (CI) | impacted? | How / Why Not | Component(s) |
|---|---|---|---|
| PolicyAdmin-Core (CI-2001) | Yes | New synchronous coverage-lookup consumer; KB-consistent | FR-002, FR-003 |
| DocVault (CI-2002) | Yes | New document bucket and retention policy for claim evidence | FR-004 |
| Notify-Hub (CI-2003) | Yes | New claim-status templates and event subscription | FR-006 |
| Legacy-Claims-Mainframe (CI-2004) | No — by architecture decision | Excluded per CON-004 and KB retirement principle. MISMATCH: CMDB REL-3002 still shows it feeding PolicyAdmin-Core — flagged, not reconciled | — |
| Enterprise-Data-Warehouse (CI-2005) | No — by architecture decision | Reporting feed is out of scope for this release (PRD); no schema change needed | — |

## Components Identified
| Requirement | Component (new/existing) | Blast Radius | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| FR-001 | Claims Intake Portal (new) | Medium | New customer-facing web/mobile UI; failure blocks FNOL but touches no shared system. Its status-tracking view (FR-007) reads from the Claim Status Store, so the Claim Status Store must be provisioned before the Portal. |
| FR-002 | Claims Intake Service (new) | High | Orchestrates validation, triage and status for every claim; single choke point on the 2 s path. |
| FR-003 | PolicyAdmin-Core (existing) | High | System of record for policy; new real-time load from every claim affects all policy consumers. |
| FR-004 | DocVault (existing) | Medium | New bucket and 10-year retention rule; existing tenants unaffected if quotas isolated. |
| FR-005 | Claims Triage Engine (new) | Medium | New rules engine calling SVC-104; a false positive delays assignment but not intake. |
| FR-006 | Notify-Hub (existing) | Low | Template and subscription additions only; no platform change. |
| FR-007 | Claim Status Store (new) | Medium | New datastore holding audit history under 10-year retention. |
| FR-002 | Claim Status Store (new) | Medium | Validation outcome is persisted as the first status event. |

## Data Model & Schema Impact
New entities: Claim, ClaimStatusEvent, FraudScreenResult (Claim Status Store). DocVault gains a claim-evidence document class with 10-year retention. PolicyAdmin-Core schema unchanged (read-only access).

## Integration Landscape & External Dependencies
- **Upstream (enterprise platform, KB-mandated):** Identity Provider — Policyholder authentication for the portal; KB principle, absent from PRD.
- **Upstream (enterprise platform, KB-mandated):** API Gateway — All service APIs must be exposed via gateway per KB; absent from PRD.
- **Third-party / internal service:** Fraud Scoring API — SVC-104 scoring endpoint consumed by the triage engine.

## Assumptions & Out of Scope
Out of scope: Enterprise-Data-Warehouse reporting feed; adjuster workbench; payments. Assumed: SVC-104 meets the 2 s budget with triage asynchronous; PolicyAdmin-Core can absorb peak FNOL volume.

## Dependency Graph
